target_description: messages mentioning the competitor product RippleMetrics — sales pipeline impact, customer evaluations, hiring activity, or feature comparisons

messages.subject: Have you evaluated RippleMetrics?
messages.body: Hi Alex — our analytics team is doing a vendor refresh and RippleMetrics keeps coming up in their shortlist. We've been a happy customer of yours for years, but the team wants a side-by-side. Can you point me to whatever comparison material you have, or set up a call with someone who can speak to the diff?

messages.subject: We're losing Bridgewater Logistics to RippleMetrics — needs decision today
messages.body: Alex, AE just got off a call with Bridgewater. They're 90% to RippleMetrics on contract value alone. We have a verbal until EOD to come back with something. Need your call on whether sales gets approval to match their per-seat number. $180K ARR at stake.

messages.subject: Q3 roadmap review — your input needed
messages.body: Hey Alex, I'm finalizing the Q3 roadmap doc by Thursday. Can you sanity-check the prioritization on the integrations track? Specifically the order between the Salesforce and HubSpot connectors. Direct report from your team.

messages.subject: All-hands deck draft v2
messages.body: Updated deck attached based on your notes from Monday. Open question on slide 14 about the Q2 retention numbers — let me know if you want me to pull those from the dashboard or if you have them handy.

messages.subject: 15-min sync this week?
messages.body: Want to grab 15 minutes to talk through the enterprise pipeline before the board meeting Friday. Anything Wed or Thu works for me.

messages.subject: Quick intro — observability platform
messages.body: Hi Alex, came across your team's job posting for an SRE and thought our observability platform might be a fit. Open to a 20-min call next week? Happy to send a deck if useful first.

messages.subject: Confidential — Director Product role at Series B
messages.body: Hi Alex, working on a Director Product search for a profitable Series B in adjacent space. Compensation top of band. Open to a confidential 20-minute conversation? Happy to send the brief if there's interest.

messages.body: Hey Alex, for our 1:1 next Tuesday I want to use the second half to talk about the senior PM track and what would need to be true for me to make that move in the next 12 months. Sending some prep doc beforehand. Direct report.
